scenes.learning_purpose: Frame the programme and the five-step journey every learner will follow.
scenes.narration: Every trial lives or dies on recruitment. ClairLabs runs an AI-enabled digital solution that owns participant identification, qualification and warm handover. The journey has five steps: primary digital screening through an online screener with initial consent, onboarding to the centralized recruitment platform, secondary human screening where RNN staff secure consent and run a detailed questionnaire, referral to the nearest or preferred site for clinical evaluation, and finally selection and recruitment - where our responsibility ends.
scenes.title: The Programme in Five Steps
scenes.visual: Animated pipeline of five connected stages, each lighting up as the narrator names it.

scenes.learning_purpose: Teach the funnel from awareness to enrollment and why retargeting is structural.
scenes.narration: Awareness starts wide: Google, Meta and endemic health sites, bought programmatically with audience segmentation that can find even rare conditions. YouTube, display and educational content build consideration. Lead forms, pre-screening tools and search ads close enrollment. And because seventy to ninety percent of people never convert on first touch, re-engagement and retargeting run through the entire funnel - not as an afterthought, but as structure.
scenes.title: The AI-Driven Funnel
scenes.visual: Funnel graphic with animated flows from awareness to close, retargeting loop glowing throughout.

scenes.learning_purpose: Show how clinicians and advocates are reached and converted into recruitment channels.
scenes.narration: Clinicians are reached three ways: digital affinity with targeted ads and geo-fencing, KOL advocacy carried on physician-to-physician trust, and offline presence where clinicians and patients actually spend time. Advocacy groups add what money cannot buy: trust. Their registries open hard-to-reach populations, AI matching filters them precisely, and ambassadors and webinars turn education into enrollment with far fewer screen failures.
scenes.title: Clinicians and Advocates
scenes.visual: Split screen: clinician outreach motions on one side, advocacy registry network on the other, converging.

scenes.learning_purpose: Name the five intelligence sources and the shift from demographics to behavior.
scenes.narration: Five intelligence sources feed identification: wearables, digital therapeutics populations, pharmacy networks, EHR-embedded matching alerts, and AI that predicts clinical decision windows and triggers messaging exactly when patients seek alternatives. Recruitment has shifted from demographics to behavior and physiology - reaching the right patient at the right clinical moment.
scenes.title: Data and Intelligence
scenes.visual: Five data streams flowing into a single matching engine that lights up a decision window.

scenes.learning_purpose: Connect site activation with the patient experience that retains participants.
scenes.narration: Sites go live fast: rapid activation, hyper-localized outreach, live performance analytics and investigator engagement. Participants stay because the experience is built for them: journey mapping that fixes pain points, real-time engagement, concierge-level personalized care, peer trust, and feedback loops that improve things now instead of at study end. The result: site referral compressed to minutes.
scenes.title: Sites and Experience
scenes.visual: Site dashboard with live metrics dissolving into a participant journey timeline with checkmarks.

scenes.learning_purpose: Close with the roadmap, the differentiators and the proof.
scenes.narration: The roadmap runs six weeks: creation and review, sponsor and IRB-ready submission, preparation and training, go-live within two days of IRB changes, then optimization. What sets the model apart: AI identification, two-tier smart screening where RNN staff speak plainly to patients, omnichannel outreach, agile site-aligned execution, experience-driven design, and cost advantage without cutting speed or compliance. The proof travels in the case studies - including sixty-one percent more patients delivered.
scenes.title: Roadmap, Edge and Proof
scenes.visual: Timeline compressing from eight weeks to six, differentiator icons assembling, results figures rising.
